headline: Uzbekistan Revises Nominal 2025 GDP Upward by 15% to $169 Billion After Census
summary: Uzbekistan recalculated its 2025 nominal gross domestic product to 2,127 trillion UZS ($169 billion). The 15% upward revision follows updated agricultural, business, and population census data.
why: Uzbekistan is Central Asia's second-largest economy by gross domestic output.
